dialogue_ability_1: Guardian, now THAT is a royal display of power! You have unlocked Blade Fury. At your command, the guardian swords will spin faster. Let the Iron Swarm worry about its own iron health for a change!
dialogue_ability_2: See the new button below my health bar? Click it — or press 1 — and unleash the fury. The power lasts only a short while, then needs time to recover. Save that whirlwind for anyone who gets a little too close to their King!
restart_confirm: Start again? Current progress will be replaced. Settings will be kept.
preferences_unsaved: Settings applied, but the browser could not save them.
